'''Sprawl 41''' was a floating ranch located in the northwest quadrant of the planet [[Tyed Kant]]. It was owned by [[Nebula Consumables]], one of the largest agricultural corporations on the planet. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents were diverted to Sprawl 41 after [[Sprawl 34]] was struck by the [[Mynock virus]].
